About RRE Ventures
------------------

RRE Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm headquartered in New York City. Since our founding in 1994 we have sought out and partnered with extraordinary entrepreneurs who seek to disrupt and transform industries.  
  
RRE is a long-term lead investor. We are active strategic, operational and financial partners with the companies we finance. We also bring to bear a highly distinctive network of relationships across multiple industries and countries, proactively assist in recruiting top-tier talent, and provide innovative PR and marketing support. You can learn more about our team and senior advisors.  
RRE manages over a billion dollars of capital across five funds. Our operation is structured, from both a team and capital standpoint, to enable us to invest in early stage companies while remaining active and participatory throughout the financing life of a venture.  
  
We define the scope of our investment horizon as products or services enabled by information technology. This has historically included virtually all expressions of software and internet technology as well as hardware and technology-enabled services.  
  
We invest across the United States and in select overseas geographies. We view New York’s burgeoning innovation economy as critically important to the creation of the next wave of large technology companies. With over fifty portfolio companies based in the New York Metro region, we are among the area’s most active investors.

About Conquer Paralysis Now
---------------------------

Conquer Paralysis Now is a leading authority on spinal cord injury research and treatment. We're backed by an international coalition of doctors, research scientists and business leaders who share a singular goal: Finding a cure for paralysis.  
  
CPN started in 2000 as the Sam Schmidt Paralysis Foundation. The founder's original intent was to fund research and provide advocacy and programming for SCI patients and their families. Though SSPF achieved many successes over the next decade, the ultimate goal remained elusive: a cure.  
  
In 2012, SSPF began investigating what it would take to turn the dream of finding a cure into a reality. It became clear that a paradigm shift was needed to reward and accelerate scientific progress. Research teams would need to share breakthroughs and failures openly. Collaboration between unlikely partners in fields like engineering, biology and business would be a critical part of the endeavor.  
  
Over the next two years, an international team of researchers meticulously defined the term cure and identified milestones for its achievement. A comprehensive plan to incentivize the world's leading scientists and entrepreneurs was also developed.  
  
With Sam Schmidt's blessing and continued involvement, Conquer Paralysis Now launched in 2014.  
  
Achieving functional recovery from chronic SCI will be a historic milestone in the advancement of human knowledge and empowerment. The dramatic moment when an individual previously diagnosed with irreversible paralysis takes his or her first steps will be celebrated around the world. It will be a testament to humanity's progress in the mastery of science and nature.  
  
We want to find a cure. We believe a cure is possible.

About COHSASA
-------------

The Council for Health Service Accreditation of Southern Africa (COHSASA), a not-for-profit organisation based in Cape Town in South Africa, assists a range of healthcare facilities to meet and maintain quality standards and thereby provide safe, quality services.  
In the past 21 years of operation, COHSASA has worked in over 600 facilities in both the public and private sectors in South Africa, Botswana, Swaziland, Lesotho, Namibia, Rwanda, Nigeria, Uganda, Zambia, Tanzania, Ghana, Egypt and Kenya. COHSASA runs programmes in a range of facilities including hospitals, clinics, hospices, emergency medical services, environmental health offices and rehabilitation/sub-acute establishments.  
There is a strong focus on building capacity. The COHSASA programme helps healthcare professionals to measure themselves against standards. This approach teaches healthcare workers how to monitor improvements using quality improvement methods, internationally accredited standards and a web-based information system.  
COHSASA has achieved global recognition and is the only African health facility accrediting body that is accredited by the International Society for Quality in Health Care (ISQua). Since it achieved its first accreditation award from ISQua in 2002, the Council has maintained its accredited status with three further accreditations. Its current ISQua accreditation status is valid until December 2018.  
Two sets of its standards – for hospitals and palliative care – are currently accredited by ISQua and COHSASA’s Surveyor Training Programme is accredited by ISQua until 2018.  
  
COHSASA offers its services to meet individual client needs so that healthcare facilities are equipped for the long-term to meet the safety and quality health needs of the population they serve in the most efficient and cost-effective manner possible.

By harnessing expertise in system design and software architecture, Jenness ensures that the company’s offerings are not only technically sound but also tailored to meet the diverse needs of clients. This commitment to quality and precision allows for inspections to be conducted on a weekly, bi-monthly, or monthly basis, providing clients with timely insights that significantly improve their bottom line.  
  
Jenness's extensive skill set—including proficiency in Unix, embedded software, and engineering management—enables SkyDog ATI to stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the industry. By fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, Jenness Keller is dedicated to delivering repeatable results that save customers time and money, ultimately transforming the way aerial thermal imaging is utilized in construction and real estate. As SkyDog ATI continues to grow, Jenness remains focused on expanding the company's capabilities and exploring new opportunities to serve a wider range of clients.

About Community Solutions
-------------------------

Community Solutions, LLC, is an Arizona based full-service Community Association Management Company that was was founded to offer unsurpassed service based on traditional values. We specialize in single family and condominium homeowner association management ranging in size from 16+ multi-family units to 3500+ unit master planned communities. A company with nearly two decades of Association management experience, we are known for our professionalism, integrity and ability to provide timely, honest service to our clients. Being from the Phoenix area, we are proud to serve local communities, providing personal service in a professional manner to each client. With offices in Ahwatukee and Maricopa, Community Solutions provides association management services from Central Phoenix throughout the East Valley area, and reaching as far south as Maricopa and Casa Grande.  
  
We provide full-service, intelligent solutions to the many issues facing homeowner associations today. Our company has the flexibility to customize solution systems and programs to fit your neighborhood's specific needs as well as your budget requirements. Communities choose their level of management from accounting only, accounting and management, to on-site management. Working with resident-managed boards, we can provide everything from consulting on Association formation through management and developer transition to resident boards. Our company has a thorough understanding and experience on architectural issues, deed restriction enforcement, security challenges, community beautification, community technology options, collection procedures, HOA loan processing and is current on Arizona legislation governing association law. We associate ourselves with experts in the business, using the most reputable of local trades. As members of many different community organizations, we have excellent contacts in the industry to assist your community.

The Shreveport Convention Center is a multi-purpose, state-of-the-art facility designed to accommodate any event, from major conventions and trade shows to intimate gatherings such as wedding receptions and banquets. SMG, the world leader in venue management, marketing and development, was founded in 1977 with the management of our first facility, the Louisiana Superdome. We soon grew to manage convention centers, exhibition halls and trade centers, arenas, stadiums, performing arts centers, theaters, and specific-use venues such as equestrian centers. SMG's clients benefit from the company’s depth of resources and its unparalleled expertise, leadership, and creative problem-solving. Our successful growth has been built on the many partnerships, relationships, and resources we have developed with our clients — both municipal and private. This unique combination of resources, relationships, and expertise has allowed SMG to define and refine the industry throughout its history. Our ownership and team of dedicated corporate support personnel make us unrivalled in the field of private facility management.

About Frisco RoughRiders
------------------------

The Frisco RoughRiders are the Double-A affiliate of the Texas Rangers and the 2022 Texas League champions. In 2023, the team is celebrating its 20th anniversary and has consistently finished in the top five among all Double-A franchises in attendance yearly. In August 2014, the RoughRiders were purchased by an ownership group led by Chuck Greenberg.  
  
Since then, the new ownership group, together with the City of Frisco, has spearheaded numerous major franchise enhancements, investing over $8 million in a wide array of facility upgrades and improvements, including a state-of-the-art HD video board, sound system, Bull Moose Saloon, InTouch Grille, Riders Outpost Team Store and the world’s largest water feature in a sports facility, the massive Choctaw Lazy River. These enhancements earned the Riders and the City of Frisco Ballpark Digest’s prestigious "Best Ballpark Renovation" award for two consecutive years (2015 and 2016).  
  
More than 140 former RoughRiders players have gone on to play Major League Baseball, including All-Stars Chris Davis, Adrian Gonzalez, Ian Kinsler, Neftali Feliz, Elvis Andrus, Rougned Odor and Nomar Mazara.

About Government of Western Australia
-------------------------------------

The Shared Services model provides an integrated framework for Whole-of-Government to leverage economies of scale through shared technology, information and processing. In the medium and long term, this framework will provide: Increased efficiencies Increased effectiveness allowing agencies to focus on core business Increased opportunities for continuous improvement Overall value for money The implementation of Shared Services allows aggregation, standardisation, simplification and automation through the use of common systems, shared access to specialist finance and human resources expertise, and reduced management and staffing overheads. Organisations all over the world are examining ways to share corporate services. For our clients, we know this delivers professional service and results. For our people, we know this experience develop skills which are transportable internationally. Shared Services is staffed by corporate service professionals who play a pivotal role in the largest corporate services reform process ever in WA. Working in this way represents a significant change for many people and we are impressed with the contribution and enthusiasm demonstrated across the sector. We are committed to bringing the best service to the public sector and this publication sets out our business services, directions and goals for the coming years. It also sets out the values we hold in operating a high performance organisation. The launch of Shared Services is a significant step in the progress of public sector reform in Western Australia.

About PT. Sulfindo Adiusaha
---------------------------

Established in 1987 as PT Indochlor Prakarsa Industries, producing Caustic soda and EDC, in 1995 PT. Sulfindo Adiusaha ("Sulfindo") expanded two subsidiaries of PT Satomo Indovyl Monomer (“SIM”), producing VCM and PT Satomo Indovyl Polymer (“SIP”) producing PVC. To improve production chain efficiency among the plants, in April 2005, the two subsidiary companies were merged into Sulfindo as surviving company.  
   
Currently, Sulfindo has annual production capacity of 320,000 DMT of Caustic Soda; 380,000 MT of EDC; 130,000 MT of VCM; and 110,000 MT of PVC which possible future capacity expansion will be continuously considered and realized along with the fast growing market demand both in domestic and overseas.  
   
  
The company's main goal is to become one of the most prominent and advanced world-class leaders in Chlor-Alkali and Vinyl-Chloride producer in South East Asia with still prioritizing employee's safety and environmental awareness.  
This has been proven with achievement of QMS ISO 9001:2015, Environment Management System ISO 140001:2015, Occupational Health & Safety Management System OHSAS 18001:2007, ISPS CODE, SNI, HALAL (from MUI), SMK3, and PROPER (from Ministry of Environment and Forestry).  
   
To ensure the reliable and sustainable power supply, Sulfindo has also established PT. Merak Energi Indonesia ("MEI"), a wholly-owned subsidiary company operating "2 x 60" MW coal-fired power generating plant which have started its operation since December 2013, with complementary of private coal unloading jetty with a capacity of 8,000 MT barge.

About City of Greater Geelong
-----------------------------

Derived from the local Wathaurong Aboriginal name for the region Jillong, Geelong is thought to mean ‘land’ or ‘cliffs’. Famous for our big city feel without the congestion, the stunning coast line, diverse night life and food culture, Geelong is a place for everyone. Located less than an hour from Melbourne, we are recognised as Victoria’s second city. Geelong is a lifestyle city with a picturesque waterfront, parks, gardens, beaches, great dining and plenty of shopping all within 20 minutes of each other. Getting around is simple with easy to navigate road networks and intelligent bus networks making for a highly accessible city. The region has a population of 225,000 residents who enjoy lifestyle options ranging from cosmopolitan inner-city, rural and semi-rural, to diverse suburban communities including many beachside townships. The Geelong region features some of the world's best surf beaches and is the entry point to the world famous Great Ocean Road. We are one of the largest local government areas in Victoria. We provide around 130 services to the municipality oversee a budget of $400M, and employ over 2,700 staff. We are a growing city, with an economy of 16,000 businesses, $1.3b in current major construction, and a labour force of over 101,000 in the key employment areas of health, manufacturing and education. We offer an exciting mix of jobs in areas as diverse as community development, arts, leisure, finance, child care, parks maintenance, aged care, IT, engineering and planning. Our Vision Greater Geelong: building our community through enterprise, opportunity and innovation in a quality environment Our Mission We will focus on developing and maintaining effective working relationships to deliver Council's strategic directions and high quality services that meet the changing needs of our community. The City is an equal opportunity employer and values the contributions a diverse workforce can bring to the community.

Jim Pickerell has been a pivotal figure in the stock photography industry since 1963, combining his extensive experience as a photographer with a deep understanding of the market dynamics that shape image licensing and pricing. As the Editor of Selling Stock, Jim has transformed what began as a bimonthly printed newsletter into a vital daily online resource for photographers and image marketers. His insights into digital photography, marketing strategies, and pricing negotiations have made Selling Stock an essential platform for professionals seeking to navigate the complexities of stock image sales.  
  
In his role, Jim not only curates and disseminates valuable content but also engages directly with industry trends, offering expert commentary on the evolving landscape of stock photography. His key projects include in-depth articles that explore the nuances of pricing strategies, particularly highlighted in his book, "Negotiating Stock Photo Prices." This guide serves as a crucial resource for photographers aiming to maximize their earnings and understand the intricacies of photo usage rights.  
  
Jim’s expertise spans various photography genres, including lifestyle, portrait, architectural, and editorial photography, allowing him to provide tailored advice to a diverse audience. His commitment to empowering photographers through education and strategic insights has solidified his reputation as a thought leader in the stock photography community. Through Selling Stock, Jim continues to advocate for photographers, helping them adapt to market changes and optimize their image marketing efforts in an increasingly digital world.

About Geremy Salts

Geremy Salts serves as a Principal Engineer at Stantec, where he brings a wealth of expertise in the management and design of complex land development projects throughout Southern California. With a focus on guiding clients through every phase of the development process—from land acquisition and entitlements to final engineering, map recordation, and construction—Geremy is a pivotal figure in ensuring project success. His extensive experience encompasses a diverse range of specialties, including conceptual design, site planning, and value engineering, which are essential for optimizing project outcomes and maximizing client satisfaction.  
  
In his current role, Geremy leads Community Development projects, where he applies his deep understanding of hillside grading, complex drainage analysis, and stormwater quality design to navigate the unique challenges posed by Southern California's varied topography and environmental regulations. His proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D allows him to create detailed and accurate site plans that facilitate effective grading and subdivision layouts. Additionally, Geremy's skills in hydrology and erosion control are crucial for developing sustainable solutions that meet both regulatory requirements and community needs.  
  
Key projects under his management often involve intricate site development tasks that require innovative approaches to grading and infrastructure design, including road and sewer systems. Geremy's commitment to value engineering not only enhances project efficiency but also ensures that clients receive the best possible return on their investments. As a leader in the field, he is dedicated to fostering collaborative relationships with stakeholders, ensuring that each project aligns with the broader vision of community development while adhering to the highest standards of engineering excellence.

About Liddy Karter

Liddy Karter serves as the Managing Partner at Mizzen Capital, where she plays a pivotal role in shaping the firm’s strategic direction and investment approach. With a keen focus on the lower middle market, Liddy has been instrumental in launching the Mizzen Bridge Fund, a private credit initiative designed to provide essential liquidity to successful U.S.-based businesses navigating the post-COVID-19 recovery landscape. This fund specifically targets companies in advanced manufacturing, IT, software, alternative energy, and healthcare services, sectors that are not only resilient but also poised for growth in the evolving economic climate.  
  
Under Liddy’s leadership, Mizzen Capital has established itself as a trusted partner for businesses seeking term loans to fuel their expansion and operational needs. Her extensive expertise in mezzanine debt and corporate finance allows her to identify and capitalize on unique investment opportunities, ensuring that the firm’s portfolio is both diversified and strategically aligned with market trends. Liddy’s background in mergers and acquisitions, coupled with her strong skills in due diligence and business strategy, enables her to navigate complex transactions and deliver value to stakeholders.  
  
In addition to her investment acumen, Liddy is committed to fostering relationships with entrepreneurs and management teams, understanding their challenges, and providing tailored financial solutions that drive sustainable growth. Her collaborative approach, combined with her strategic insights, positions Mizzen Capital as a leader in the private credit space, dedicated to empowering lower middle market businesses to thrive in an increasingly competitive environment.

We take pride in partnering with forward-thinking businesses and organizations who recognize the growing need for employee caregiver support systems. We advocate for employee caregivers because of the tangible impact that caring for a loved one has on an employee's physical, financial and emotional well-being. As more and more organizations recognize the needs of their employee caregivers, our innovative Caregiver Support Platform is here to ensure that no one goes through the process of caring for loved ones alone.

• 2021 : Création de Nomad by Odalys Plein Air, nouveau concept d'hébergement de plein air en harmonie avec la nature.

Türk Bankasi Ltd. is a private capital bank with a presence in North Cyprus; its paid-up capital is 70 million TL. Its network covers 20 branches and 27 ATMs.  
Our Bank is a member of TurkishBank Group with an asset size of 1 billion 100 million USD and an equity of 180 million USD, covering a network of 47 branches in total in Turkey, TRNC and England.

About Deborah Levy

Deborah Levy is a renowned British novelist and playwright known for her powerful and thought-provoking literary works. With a career spanning over three decades, Levy has established herself as a major figure in contemporary literature, receiving widespread acclaim for her innovative storytelling and insightful exploration of the human experience.  
  
Born and raised in South Africa, Levy moved to England as a teenager and later studied drama at Dartington College of Arts. Her early exposure to different cultures and experiences undoubtedly influences her writing, infusing her work with a unique perspective and deep understanding of the complexities of human existence.  
  
Levy's literary career began with her debut novel "Beautiful Mutants" in 1986, followed by "Swallowing Geography" in 1993. However, it was her semi-autobiographical novel "Things I Don't Want to Know" (2013) that brought her widespread recognition. In this poignant and lyrical memoir, Levy delves into her own life experiences while reflecting on themes of identity, womanhood, and the nature of storytelling. The work received critical acclaim for its raw honesty and poetic prose, cementing Levy's reputation as a fearless and unflinching writer.  
  
Levy's success continued with her acclaimed "Living Autobiography" trilogy, which includes the novels "Hot Milk" (2016), "The Man Who Saw Everything" (2019), and "Real Estate" (2021). These novels showcase Levy's masterful storytelling and keen observation of human relationships, as well as her ability to blur the line between fiction and reality. With her trademark blend of intellect and emotion, Levy creates compelling narratives that resonate with readers on a profound level.  
  
In addition to her novels, Levy is also an accomplished playwright, with works such as "Heresies" (2018) and "The B File" (2019) showcasing her talent for creating immersive and thought-provoking theatrical experiences. With her diverse body of work, Levy continues to push boundaries and challenge conventional literary norms, earning a reputation as a trailblazer in contemporary literature.  
  
Levy's writing has garnered numerous accolades, including being shortlisted for the Man Booker Prize for "Hot Milk" and "The Man Who Saw Everything." She has also been a finalist for the Goldsmiths Prize and has received the Prix Femina étranger for "The Man Who Saw Everything." Her work has been translated into multiple languages and has earned her a dedicated readership around the world.  
  
Beyond her literary accomplishments, Levy is also known for her insightful essays and thought-provoking commentary on contemporary issues. Her writing often delves into topics such as feminism, politics, and the nature of creativity, reflecting her deep engagement with the world around her and her commitment to challenging the status quo.  
  
In summary, Deborah Levy is a formidable literary talent whose work has consistently pushed the boundaries of storytelling and captivated readers with its emotional depth and intellectual rigor. With her fearless exploration of the human condition and her innovative approach to narrative, Levy has solidified her place as one of the most influential voices in contemporary literature. Her impact on the literary landscape is undeniable, and her work continues to inspire and provoke thought in readers around the world.

About Chinook Therapeutics, Inc.
--------------------------------

Chinook Therapeutics (Nasdaq: KDNY) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision medicines for kidney diseases. Chinook’s product candidates are being investigated in rare, severe chronic kidney disorders with opportunities for well-defined clinical pathways. Chinook’s lead program is atrasentan, a phase 3 endothelin receptor antagonist for the treatment of IgA nephropathy and other proteinuric glomerular diseases. BION-1301, an anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody is being evaluated in a phase 1b trial for IgA nephropathy. In addition, Chinook is advancing CHK-336, an oral small molecule LDHA inhibitor for the treatment of primary hyperoxaluria, as well as research programs for other rare, severe chronic kidney diseases. Chinook is building its pipeline by leveraging insights in kidney single cell RNA sequencing, human-derived organoids and new translational models, to discover and develop therapeutics with differentiating mechanisms of action against key kidney disease pathways. Chinook has locations in Vancouver, BC, Seattle, WA and Oakland, CA. To learn more, visit www.chinooktx.com.

About Eurogentec
----------------

Eurogentec, part of Kaneka Corporation, is an international biotechnology supplier, based in Belgium, who specializes in genomics and proteomics. The company is fully ISO 9001, ISO 13485 certified, cGMP accredited by the Belgian Ministry of Health and approved by the US FDA for the commercial manufacturing of a biologic for the US market.  
  
Eurogentec was founded in 1985. Through its three inter-related business units (BU), the company provides high quality products to scientists involved in the life science, biotechnology, diagnostic and pharmaceutical markets.  
  
The life science BU specializes in Genomics (e.g. Lab scale to Large scale Oligonucleotides, PCR/qPCR Kits & Reagents and Assay Dispensing Service) and Proteomics (e.g. catalog and custom peptides & antibodies including a 28-Day Speedy protocol, assay kits and Proprietary Dyes & Quenchers).  
  
The In Vitro Diagnostics BU provides technical and project support for contract manufacturing of GMP oligonucleotides and Taq DNA polymerases for use in Molecular Diagnostic applications.  
  
The Biomanufacturing BU is a GMP Biomanufacturer specialized in the technology transfer, process development, scale-up and manufacturing of proteins, plasmids and vaccines for pre-clinical, clinical and commercial uses, all according to FDA and EMA requirements.

About Butler University College of Pharmacy & Health Sciences
-------------------------------------------------------------

Butler University College of Pharmacy & Health Sciences, located at 4600 Sunset Ave, Indianapolis, Indiana, has been a cornerstone of healthcare education since its establishment in 1904. The college is dedicated to fostering a community of health professionals who are committed to excellence and innovation in their fields. With a rigorous curriculum and a supportive learning environment, students are encouraged to explore various career pathways through experiential education with leading clinicians. This hands-on approach, combined with strong partnerships with local healthcare systems and businesses, ensures that graduates are well-prepared to become leaders in the healthcare industry.  
  
The College offers a comprehensive range of programs, including the Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), Master of Science in Pharmaceutical Sciences (MSPS), Master of Physician Assistant Studies (MPAS), and Bachelor degrees in Health Science and Healthcare & Business. Additionally, students can pursue dual degree options such as the PharmD/MBA with the Lacy School of Business and the PharmD/MS in Pharmaceutical Sciences. The Pharmacy program is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Pharmacy Education and is a member of the American Association of Colleges of Pharmacy, while the Physician Assistant Program holds accreditation from the Accreditation Review Commission on Education for the Physician Assistant and is a member of the Physician Assistant Education Association.  
  
Butler's professional programs consistently achieve above-national average board passing rates, reflecting the quality of education and training provided. For those interested in the faculty, the Butler University College of Pharmacy & Health Sciences teachers list showcases a diverse group of experienced educators dedicated to student success and professional development. With a focus on excellence and community engagement, Butler University continues to shape the future of healthcare through its innovative programs and dedicated faculty.

As President of Black Swan Textiles, Keith Hoover is at the forefront of revolutionizing the textile industry through innovative digital solutions and strategic thinking. His leadership in developing the BlackOPS Fabric Decoder (BFD) and Arsenal has been pivotal in standardizing fabric definitions and streamlining the organization, development, and replication processes. This groundbreaking approach enables designers and manufacturers to efficiently search, select, and match fabrics with precision, akin to color management, thereby fostering a more agile production environment.  
  
Keith's expertise in color management and digitalization is complemented by his critical thinking and trend analysis skills, which he applies to anticipate market shifts and consumer preferences. His regular contributions to the AATCC Review, particularly in the "The Second C" color management column, showcase his commitment to advancing industry knowledge and best practices. As a mentor for Fashion For Good, Keith is dedicated to nurturing the next generation of textile innovators, sharing insights on sustainable practices and the importance of digital product creation in a rapidly evolving landscape.  
  
Through his work at Black Swan Textiles, Keith Hoover exemplifies the intersection of technology and creativity, empowering the industry to produce "cool sh!t" faster and more efficiently while maintaining a keen focus on quality and sustainability. His vision and expertise continue to inspire colleagues and industry peers alike, making him a key player in the future of textile manufacturing.

About Black Swan Textiles
-------------------------

Why is sourcing fabric so challenging? Today, apparel designers have little exposure to the complexity of fabric manufacturing and most mills don’t understand what drives apparel product design. The way we design, source, and manufacture garments is disconnected and archaic. Many companies will witness extinction and be rendered obsolete if they ignore the Black Swan event that is happening in the apparel industry.  
  
The digital standard is here…BlackOPS  
  
The idea of a swan in a color other than white was considered absurd until a black swan was discovered in 1697. It demonstrated that new facts undermine certainty. A “Black Swan event” is defined as an occurrence in history that was unprecedented and unexpected at the time it occurred. However, after evaluating the surrounding context, domain experts can usually conclude, “It was bound to happen.” Apparel digitalization is a Black Swan event that will be exploited by applying technology to change development processes across the entire industry, regardless of location, product grade, or price point.  
  
Black Swan Textiles accepts the mission of reimagining product development, sourcing, and manufacturing processes in the apparel industry. Our software platform, BlackOPS, is a design-for-manufacturing software platform that digitizes subject matter expertise between fashion brands and suppliers. We solve complex supply chain challenges by combining innovative applications, intelligent algorithms, and technology integrations in an easy to use toolbox.  
  
The initial BlackOPS application, Fabric Digital Twin, is the world’s first searchable fabric store that digitizes the ~$750 billion global textiles market. How much time and resources go into fabric sourcing allocation? The fabric digital twin simplifies this task. Conventional labor-intensive and analog processes are made irrelevant by enabling a global materials database that is searchable on key fabric criteria, locating the material in seconds rather than days.

She began sharing her projects and tutorials on her blog, Ana White, and it wasn't long before she garnered a loyal following of like-minded individuals who were eager to learn from her expertise.

She firmly believes that anyone can learn to build their own furniture, regardless of their level of experience or skill. Her projects are designed to be approachable for beginners while still offering a challenge for more advanced woodworkers. By breaking down complex designs into manageable steps and providing detailed instructions and diagrams, Ana empowers her readers to take on ambitious projects with confidence.  
  
In addition to her blog, Ana has also published several books and created a thriving online community centered around DIY and woodworking. What sets Ana apart as a blogger and DIY influencer is her genuine and personable approach. She doesn't just showcase her finished projects; she invites her audience to join her in the process, sharing her successes and failures along the way. Her willingness to be vulnerable and transparent about the challenges of DIY work fosters a sense of camaraderie among her followers and encourages them to embrace the learning curve that comes with tackling new projects.  
  
Ana's impact extends beyond the digital realm, as she actively seeks to give back to her community and promote the value of handmade craftsmanship. She has partnered with organizations such as Habitat for Humanity to support affordable housing initiatives and has been a vocal advocate for the importance of learning practical skills like woodworking. Through her work, she has inspired countless individuals to pick up a saw and hammer and take pride in creating items for their homes with their own hands.  
  
In conclusion, Ana White's influence as a blogger and DIY advocate cannot be overstated. Her dedication to fostering a welcoming and inclusive community of makers has made woodworking and home improvement more accessible and enjoyable for people from all walks of life. With her passion for teaching and her commitment to empowering others to take on DIY projects, Ana has undoubtedly left an indelible mark on the world of DIY and woodworking. Mark Kokopelli Watkins is a multifaceted creative force at the Coalition of Independent Authors, where he leverages his extensive background as a published author and artist to inspire and empower fellow writers. His commitment to community service is evident in his philanthropic efforts, having donated over 25 art pieces to charitable causes, further solidifying his reputation as a socially conscious artist. As a professional actor and SAG member in good standing, Mark also brings a unique perspective to his work, blending performance art with written narratives to create immersive experiences for his audience.

His professional development seminars are designed to equip aspiring authors with the tools they need to navigate the publishing landscape, fostering a supportive environment for creativity and growth. About Civicorps
---------------

Since Civicorps’ founding in 1983 as one of the first conservation corps in California, we have refined our Academic and Professional Pathway to meet the needs of opportunity youth, age 18-26. In 1995, we strengthened our education program when Oakland Unified School District granted us a charter to become a high-school diploma program – making us the only dropout recovery school for the entire district.  
  
Located in West Oakland, almost all (99%) of our students live in poverty and are an ethnic minority, 50% are formerly incarcerated, 50% are struggling with homelessness, 40% have learning disabilities, 35% are parents of young children, and 24% are former foster youth. Civicorps’ mission is to re-engage young adults to earn a high-school diploma, gain job skills, pursue college, and embark on family-sustaining careers.  
  
In addition to our charter school, we operate two social enterprises (Environmental Management and Recycling), which allow us to hire our students, provide high-impact job training, generate unrestricted revenue for our agency, and develop a network of employer partners who are eager to hire Civicorps graduates.  
  
Civicorps’ Academic and Professional Pathway is a multi-stage, full-time, long-term program (14 to 24 months) that helps out-of-school youth earn a high-school diploma, work their first job while gaining job training, and advance to college and/or internships, pre-apprenticeships, or union apprenticeships with our business partners. This effective program model is supported by comprehensive wraparound services where students have access to 12 support staff in addition to their Teachers and Job Training Supervisors.  
  
Not only is our graduation rate 72% (one of the highest in Oakland), but also one year after graduation, 73% of our graduates are still enrolled in college and/or employed. This success ripples out into the community, creating a legacy of achievement for Oakland.  
  
Contact us to get involved as a volunteer or donor!

Alignment to MITRE ATT&CK® is crucial as it provides a framework for understanding and categorizing cyber threats and adversary tactics. SentinelOne's solutions leverage this framework to enhance threat detection and response capabilities, allowing organizations to better anticipate and defend against potential attacks by understanding the techniques and procedures used by cyber adversaries.

How does SentinelOne ensure early detection of threats?

SentinelOne employs advanced machine learning algorithms and behavioral analysis to ensure early detection of threats. By continuously monitoring endpoint activity and analyzing patterns, the platform can identify anomalies and potential threats before they can cause significant damage. This proactive approach allows organizations to respond quickly and effectively to emerging threats.

About webfire
-------------

webfire is an award winning studio specialising in digital projects. Our areas of specialism are mobile + tablet app design and development, and web app design and development. Additionally we do a lot of web work, including bespoke, content managed websites and responsive websites working across desktop, tablet, and mobile.  
  
Founded in 2002 by Gareth Evans, webfire has gained a reputation for taking digital projects from concept to launch, and working with many repeat clients over the years - a testimony to our focus on exceeding customer expectations.  
  
Our clients come from a wide range of industries, and no project is ever the same. We work with all types of businesses from startups to global blue-chip organisations. Our work isn't limited to the UK, many of our clients are based overseas, and we don't see physical location as a barrier to working different organisations from across the globe. Our offices are situated next door to London's ExCeL centre in Royal Docks.  
  
Everything we do revolves around user-centred design and usability. Making things as beautiful and easy-to-use as possible is our mission. We are independent and we mix client work with our own independent, self-funded projects which allow us the flexibility to experiment and learn, and feed this knowledge back into our client work.  
  
We always question things and take a proactive approach to helping advise our clients intelligently before starting any work. This consultancy element of our offering is invaluable to many of our clients who look to us for advice on their digital projects.

About Conker Group
------------------

Over the past decade we have built a SaaS system specifically for FMCG/CPG suppliers and it is used by some of the biggest names in Grocery. We give our customers an edge in a highly competitive market, with real time and near-real time reporting systems.  
  
REAL TIME REPORTING  
Availability Manager processes, cleans, and harmonises (E)POS data and can issue detailed reports, alerts and insights less than 10 minutes after data is received, even for suppliers with hundreds of SKUs. It keeps all areas of a business informed and ‘on the same page’ - it can also help field sales teams target stores with the highest potential ROI.  
  
EVERY FACT AT YOUR FINGERTIPS  
We are passionate about making systems that help our customers be outstanding suppliers, by putting every fact at their fingertips. This is epitomised by our new iPad app which can instantly answer sales questions, even when querying years of history across hundreds of SKUs - and all functionality is available offline.  
  
AI-DRIVEN IMAGE RECOGNITION  
We constantly develop new Availability Manager tools. The latest is an AI-driven system which delivers insights from a few instore photos. It’s the most accurate Image Recognition system on the market when it comes to measuring Share of Space and Planogram/Range Compliance.

About Learnlight
----------------

We're an EdTech company that’s passionate about putting trainers at the heart of the learning experience because that’s what delivers life-changing impact. We use award-winning technology to deliver language, intercultural and communication skills training online and on the ground, to learners in more than 180 countries. Our company was founded in 2007 with a dream to bridge the gap between the disparate worlds of education and technology. Our vision was to create an ‘EdTech’ company that harnessed cutting-edge technology to optimize instructor-led training (ILT) rather than replace it, as so many traditional eLearning providers have tried and failed to do. Our obsession was, and continues to be, empowering talented trainers to create transformative learning experiences, because, at the end of the day, we think people are the real ‘killer app’.  
  
Since our early years as a digital start-up, we’ve worked with hundreds of blue chips and international institutions across the world. Today our training services are used by more than 1,200 companies and by over 500,000 employees. We started in Spain however today we have offices across Europe and a team of more than 200 incredible professionals.

What services does Queen of Raw provide?

Queen of Raw specializes in providing sustainable solutions for textile waste management. Their services include a marketplace for buying and selling unused textiles, consulting on waste reduction strategies, and offering tools for companies to track and manage their fabric inventory. They aim to help businesses reduce their environmental impact while also creating economic value from surplus materials.

How does the marketplace work?

The Queen of Raw marketplace connects sellers of unused textiles with buyers looking for sustainable fabric options. Sellers can list their surplus materials, while buyers can browse through a wide range of fabrics available for purchase. The platform facilitates transactions and provides resources to ensure that both parties have a smooth experience. This marketplace not only helps reduce waste but also promotes the circular economy in the fashion and textile industries.

Who can benefit from Queen of Raw's solutions?

Queen of Raw's solutions are beneficial for a variety of stakeholders in the textile and fashion industries, including manufacturers, retailers, designers, and brands looking to minimize waste and enhance sustainability. Additionally, organizations focused on environmental impact and waste reduction can leverage Queen of Raw's expertise and marketplace to find innovative ways to manage their textile surplus.

What types of textiles can be sold on the Queen of Raw platform?

The Queen of Raw platform accepts a wide range of unused textiles, including but not limited to, rolls of fabric, off-cuts, and surplus materials from production runs. This includes various types of fabrics such as cotton, polyester, silk, and blends. Sellers are encouraged to provide detailed descriptions and images of their textiles to attract potential buyers effectively.

How does Queen of Raw support sustainability in the fashion industry?

Queen of Raw supports sustainability by providing a platform that encourages the reuse and recycling of textiles, thereby reducing waste in the fashion industry. Their marketplace allows for the sale of unused materials, which helps prevent these textiles from ending up in landfills. Additionally, Queen of Raw offers consulting services to help companies develop strategies for reducing their overall environmental footprint and implementing sustainable practices throughout their supply chains.

Is there a fee to list textiles on the Queen of Raw marketplace?

Yes, there is a fee associated with listing textiles on the Queen of Raw marketplace. The fee structure is designed to be affordable and accessible, encouraging sellers to participate in the platform. Specific details regarding fees can be found on their website or by contacting their customer support team for more information. This fee helps maintain the platform and supports the ongoing mission of reducing textile waste.

About Vision Pursue
-------------------

Vision Pursue (VP) uses training, coaching and our proprietary app to improve the way people experience the external world. We call this Performance Mindset™. A group of people can have the same external experience and have totally different internal experiences solely based on their mental processing or mindset.  
  
How do you experience a typical workday?  
  
Our surveys show that most people experience a typical workday as primarily stressful, annoying and monotonous. They also have trouble focusing, being present at home and sleeping.  
  
What’s the point of “succeeding” if this is how you experience work and life?  
  
How can you create an inspired culture when people are having a negative life experience?  
  
VP’s training, coaching, and app contain the mental skills that improve life experience by improving mindset. These skills include focusing on the process, emotional response, mindfulness, and meditation. The skills used by many elite athletes and sports teams.  
  
Stress is reduced, and focus, sleep, and enjoyment are enhanced. Once the mind is right, culture, performance, and results follow.  
  
VP is fortunate to work with great customers like the Atlanta Falcons, San Francisco 49ers, Teva Neuroscience, Exelon, CME Group, Northwestern Mutual, Mizuho Securities, Seattle Mariners, Miami Heat, Kansas City Mo. Police Department, United Way, and Kansas State University.

About PCAOB
-----------

The PCAOB is a nonprofit corporation established by Congress to oversee the audits of public companies in order to protect investors and further the public interest in the preparation of informative, accurate, and independent audit reports. The PCAOB also oversees the audits of brokers and dealers registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), including compliance reports filed pursuant to federal securities laws.  
  
The PCAOB has four primary duties:  
\- Register public accounting firms that prepare audit reports for issuers, and SEC-registered brokers and dealers.  
\- Establish or adopt auditing and related attestation, quality control, ethics, and independence standards.  
\- Inspect registered public accounting firms' audits and quality control systems.  
\- Investigate and discipline registered public accounting firms and their associated persons for violations of specified laws, rules, or professional standards.  
  
In support of our mission, we also conduct economic research and risk analysis, engage with our stakeholders and other domestic and international regulators, and manage a talented workforce and the technology and resources we need to perform our duties.  
  
The SEC has oversight authority over the PCAOB, including the approval of the Board's rules, standards, and budget.  
  
The PCAOB has approximately 800 staff members. We maintain our headquarters in Washington, D.C., and have 15 other offices or locations across the United States. As of December 31, 2021, in 83 jurisdictions across the globe, 1,709 public accounting firms were registered with the PCAOB.

The hotel is proud to feature a glamorous competition-size pool, constantly voted the best in the city by nearly every local media outlet. About GlobeTax
--------------

GlobeTax was founded in 1992 to master the complex and ever-changing landscape of double taxation treaties and help all investors maximize investment returns. Over the past three decades, the firm has become the world’s leading provider of withholding tax recovery solutions to meet the needs of every participant in the global custody chain.  
  
For investors seeking to recover taxes through relief at source, quick refund, and post-payable reclaim processes, GlobeTax provides a comprehensive outsourced recovery solution. In this capacity, we procure all documentation, monitor cross-border income, manage elections, file reclaim applications, and perform follow up, ensuring that all entitlements are returned to client accounts. GlobeTax services financial institutions such as banks and brokers, as well as investors such as hedge funds, asset managers, pensions, endowments, family offices, and high net worth individuals, among others.  
  
In addition to recovering taxes on behalf of financial institutions and their investor clients, GlobeTax serves as the primary tax processing agent for all four ADR-issuing depositary banks in the United States, and helps global market infrastructure providers such as CSDs, custodians, and local agents similarly manage inbound claims.  
  
In these combined capacities, we process more than 7 million reclaims a year for clients in more than 40 countries.

What services does GlobeTax provide for investors dealing with double taxation?

GlobeTax specializes in helping investors navigate the complexities of double taxation treaties. Our services include withholding tax recovery, tax relief at source, and comprehensive cross-border tax treaty research. We aim to maximize investment returns by ensuring that clients benefit from applicable tax treaties, thus minimizing their tax liabilities.

How does GlobeTax assist with withholding tax recovery?

GlobeTax offers a streamlined process for withholding tax recovery, where we handle the entire claim process on behalf of our clients. Our team of experts ensures that all necessary documentation is accurately prepared and submitted to the relevant tax authorities, allowing investors to reclaim taxes withheld on their cross-border investments efficiently.

Our eCerts service allows clients to obtain electronic certifications for tax treaty benefits, streamlining the process and reducing the time and effort required to manage tax compliance.

What is the role of GlobeTax as a transfer agent and CSD service provider?

We ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and facilitate efficient processing of transactions, which is crucial for investors engaging in cross-border investments.

How does GlobeTax ensure compliance with changing tax regulations?

GlobeTax stays at the forefront of tax regulation changes by continuously monitoring global tax laws and treaties. Konsulentvirksomheden Silverbullet arbejder i spændingsfeltet mellem mennesker, strategi og teknologi, hvor vi hjælper vore kunder med at koble forretning og IT. Såvel når det handler om at analysere og udvikle virksomheder gennem valg, som når det omhandler implementering og udnyttelse af digitale løsninger og ny teknologi  
Vi kalder det Technology Management Consulting – strategisk rådgivning om IT til ledelsen i bred forstand. Under denne overskrift leverer vi projektledelse, analyser og rådgivning i forbindelse med bl.a. digital transformation, it-governance, it-arkitektur, udbud og valg af it-systemer.  
Silverbullets team består af erfarne konsulenter med omfattende ledelses- og projektledelseserfaring fra it-branchen, management consulting. Vi har fokus på såvel den offentlige som den private sektor og har indgående ekspertiser på sundheds- og socialområdet samt fra transport-, forsynings- og finanssektorerne.  
  
Navnet Silverbullet refererer til Turing Award-vinderen Frederik P. Brooks verdenskendte artikel ”No Silver Bullet”, der adresserer de vigtigste kriterier for succesfuld rådgivning: Unik viden, respekt for opgaven og indsigt i det specifikke projekt.

About Benchmark Analytics

Benchmark Analytics® was founded by a group of dedicated professionals with years of experience in law enforcement — along with deep expertise in the power of Data Science, evidence-based research and advanced technology for developing solutions proven to evolve personnel management in modern policing.  
  
With Benchmark Management System® (BMS), we close the current knowledge gaps in the marketplace by tracking, organizing and analyzing all data points associated with a police department’s sworn and non-sworn officers. We work with agencies to develop a comprehensive, top-to-bottom police force management system.  
  
First Sign® Early Intervention is the only research-based, data science-driven EIS in policing available today. First Sign leverages the world’s largest officer performance database with over 20 million records — developed in collaboration with the University of Chicago to deliver the most effective tool to identify off-track officer behavior. First Sign goes well beyond standard early warning systems by establishing benchmarks that more accurately identify levels of at-risk behavior . . . alerting you to the real need of intervention and officer support.  
  
Our Care Action Response Engine® (C.A.R.E) platform helps supervisors develop a deliberate, meaningful plan of action to help officers who have fallen off track get back on track — and out of C.A.R.E.  
  
Our mission is to transform police force management through an all-in-one, data management and early intervention system that provides a holistic view of every officer — in police departments of every size.

About Mon Chasseur Immo - Chasseur Immobilier

Mon Chasseur Immo® est aujourd’hui le 1er réseau de chasseurs immobiliers en France avec plus de 150 chasseurs immobiliers présents dans toutes les grandes villes. Nativement digital et avec son modèle économique de type plateforme, Mon Chasseur Immo® a réinventé l’acte d’achat en alliant le meilleur de l’humain et du digital. Grâce à une application mobile dédiée, l’acheteur immobilier suit l’intégralité de son projet en ligne et visualise des biens ultra qualifiés avec des descriptions précises. Il bénéficie des services d’un Chasseur Immo dédié qui effectue à sa place toutes les démarches grâce, lui aussi, à des outils digitaux exclusifs. Un seul objectif : faire de l’acte d’achat immobilier, l’expérience la plus simple, la plus efficace et la plus sereine possible, tant pour habiter que pour investir.  
  
Crée par Frédéric Bourelly en 2012, Mon Chasseur Immo® compte déjà une vingtaine de collaborateurs basés au siège de Montpellier au sein du Village by CA (accélérateur du Crédit Agricole), avec des bureaux à Paris, Lyon, Montpellier et Bordeaux. Classé 29ème national au Fast 50 Deloitte et lauréat du Pass French Tech durant 2 années consécutives, Mon Chasseur Immo® a, en quelques années, accéléré fortement son développement avec plus de 3 000 missions confiées et un chiffre d’affaires multiplié par 4 en 3 ans.

About Summit Midstream Partners, LP
-----------------------------------

Summit Midstream Partners, LP (NYSE: SMLP) is a growth-oriented master limited partnership focused on developing, owning and operating midstream energy infrastructure assets that are strategically located in the core producing areas of unconventional resource basins, primarily shale formations, in the continental United States. SMLP currently provides natural gas, crude oil and produced water gathering services pursuant to primarily long-term and fee-based gathering and processing agreements with our customers and counter parties in six unconventional resource basins:  
  
• The Appalachian Basin, which includes the Marcellus and Utica shale formations in West Virginia and Ohio  
• The Williston Basin, which includes the Bakken and Three Forks shale formations in North Dakota  
• The Fort Worth Basin, which includes the Barnett Shale formation in Texas  
• The Piceance Basin, which includes the Mesaverde formation as well as the Mancos and Niobrara shale formations in Colorado and Utah  
• The Denver-Julesburg Basin, which includes the Niobrara and Codell shale formations in Colorado  
• The Permian Basin, which includes the Bone Spring and Wolfcamp formations in New Mexico;  
  
SMLP also owns a 40% interest in a joint venture that is developing natural gas gathering and condensate stabilization infrastructure in the Utica Shale in Ohio. SMLP is headquartered in Houston, Texas with regional corporate offices in Denver, Colorado and Atlanta, Georgia.

About l'Oiseau Rare
-------------------

Le cabinet l’Oiseau Rare est une société française qui a pour vocation d’accompagner les départements innovations et systèmes d’information des grands groupes des secteurs de la Banque, de l’Assurance, de l’Industrie et des Télécoms, dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets.  
  
L’Oiseau Rare s’est créé sur des valeurs humaines et professionnelles fortes dans un environnement de “guerre des talents” et autour d’un concept fort : ” Nous sommes tous l’Oiseau Rare d’une équipe ou d’un projet “  
  
Les bons talents, au bon endroit, au bon moment et fédérés autour d’une communauté soudée.  
  
Dans ce contexte, l’Oiseau Rare s’engage auprès de ses clients à trouver et sélectionner leur Oiseau Rare où qu’il se trouve, en prenant en considération le savoir-être tout autant que le savoir-faire ! Le Cabinet s’engage également auprès de ses Oiseaux Rares à ce que leur réalité au quotidien soit fidèle à la promesse qui leur est faite.  
  
Dans la pratique, l’Oiseau Rare a développé une méthodologie agile du traitement des demandes clients, centrée sur les exigences opérationnelles. L’efficacité de cette méthodologie repose sur la proximité et la connaissance des équipes opérationnelles et sur l’adaptabilité à leurs contraintes.  
  
En parallèle, l’Oiseau Rare capitalise sur son Label OR, une communauté de consultants expérimentés et reconnus pour leur excellence professionnelle et relationnelle.

About Main Street Planning Group
--------------------------------

Main Street Planning Group was founded in 2009 by Neil Himmelstein as a full-service insurance brokerage firm designed to accommodate the needs of agencies, agents and clients with comprehensive products and services to help save and protect client’s assets.  
  
We accomplish this daily using our Code, which is the backbone of how we conduct business. Our Code is comprised of four main components:  
  
Choice - At Main Street Planning Group, we recognize that no life insurance and annuities carrier has all the best products under one roof. That’s why we have chosen to be vendor agnostic, meaning we maintain the freedom to choose products from different life insurance and annuities carriers. This puts us in a unique position to choose the best products from each company based on our client’s needs.  
  
Organization - We maintain an extensive network of professionals including attorneys, CPAs, commercial and residential bankers, real estate agents, marketing experts and other professionals in every area of financial planning. Committed to the ongoing education of our network, we recently created a digital education program to keep our associates completely up-to-date with the latest economic conditions.  
  
Direction - We take pride in our ability to provide our clients with direction on how best to save and protect their assets at every step along their financial journey.  
  
Education - In order for us to best advise our clients, we begin by understanding the full breadth of their financial situations and goals. We then create and communicate the plans we’ve created with our clients, making sure they understand everything we’re advising, and how it will positively impact their financial security.  
  
After more than a decade of successful practice, Main Street Planning Group still upholds its commitment to provide our clients with choice, organization, direction and education. It’s our commitment to our Code that our clients count on, and that sets Main Street Planning Group apart.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Impact Sciences Inc.

What types of environmental assessments does Impact Sciences provide?

Impact Sciences specializes in a variety of environmental assessments, including Noise Assessments, Air Quality evaluations, and comprehensive Environmental Impact Reports (EIRs). We also conduct assessments related to greenhouse gases and comply with both NEPA (National Environmental Policy Act) and CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act) regulations. Our goal is to ensure that all environmental factors are thoroughly evaluated to support sustainable development.

How does Impact Sciences approach community engagement during environmental assessments?

At Impact Sciences, we prioritize community engagement as a fundamental part of our assessment process. We believe that informing communities and fostering open communication is essential for successful projects. We conduct public meetings, workshops, and outreach initiatives to gather input and address concerns from community members. This collaborative approach helps us create solutions that are not only environmentally sound but also socially responsible.

What industries does Impact Sciences serve?

Impact Sciences serves a diverse range of industries, including real estate development, transportation, energy, and public infrastructure. Our expertise in environmental planning and assessments allows us to support projects across various sectors, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations while promoting sustainable practices. Whether it's a residential development or a large-scale infrastructure project, we tailor our services to meet the specific needs of each industry.

What is the significance of NEPA and CEQA in environmental planning?

NEPA (National Environmental Policy Act) and CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act) are critical frameworks for environmental planning in the United States. NEPA requires federal agencies to assess the environmental impacts of their proposed actions before making decisions, while CEQA mandates similar assessments for state and local agencies in California. Both regulations aim to promote informed decision-making and public participation in the environmental review process, which is where Impact Sciences plays a vital role in ensuring compliance and effective communication.

Can Impact Sciences assist with compliance for greenhouse gas regulations?

Yes, Impact Sciences has extensive experience in assessing and managing greenhouse gas emissions as part of our environmental planning services. We help clients navigate the complexities of local, state, and federal greenhouse gas regulations by conducting thorough assessments and providing actionable strategies to reduce emissions. Our goal is to support sustainable development while ensuring compliance with environmental standards.

What makes Impact Sciences different from other environmental consulting firms?

Impact Sciences stands out due to our commitment to building lasting partnerships based on trust and transparency. We take the time to understand the unique needs of each client and project, ensuring that our solutions are tailored and effective. Our team of experts combines technical knowledge with a strong emphasis on community engagement, allowing us to deliver comprehensive environmental assessments that not only meet regulatory requirements but also foster positive relationships with stakeholders.

The European Young Bar Association (EYBA) is a non-profit association of young lawyers. Founded on 23 May 1993 in Prague, it brings together young bar associations from across Europe in one representative organisation, providing a unified voice for young lawyers on a continent-wide basis.  
  
EYBA members comprise of individuals and young bar associations/ law societies. It reflects the diversity of modern European legal practice, including young lawyers in a variety of full-service global, regional and national law firms, and public sector lawyers working for their governments.  
  
The EYBA currently represents over 200,000 young lawyers protecting their interests and organising courses, conferences, events, meetings and networking sessions.  
  
Since 2018, the EYBA was granted a participatory status at the Conference of Independent Non-governmental Organisations (INGOs) of the Council of Europe.

About Digital Envoy
-------------------

Launched in 1999, Digital Envoy introduced the concept of privacy-sensitive IP-based geolocation and IP intelligence, allowing businesses—from ad networks to publishers to websites to retailers and more—to harness the power of location and new intelligence about connected users for a multitude of mission-critical applications.  
  
In 2005 Digital Envoy introduced two divisions to help best address the unique needs of its diverse audience segments and business applications: Digital Element, which was created to continue the legacy of providing global geolocation data and services that bring anytime, anywhere relevance and context to online and mobile initiatives; and Digital Resolve, which was launched to deliver solutions that proactively secure online accounts, information, transactions and interactions from login to logout. Landmark Media Enterprises is the majority owner of Digital Envoy.  
  
In August of 2021, Digital Envoy acquired Outlogic, a provider of location data for the retail, real estate and financial markets. Outlogic has exemplified high standards and best practices for the collection and use of location data while still allowing companies to develop disruptive tools built on a foundation of quality data.

About Upper Limits Rock Gym & Pro Shop
--------------------------------------

Upper Limits has something for everyone. We have many different rooms and areas for a total of more than 20,000 square feet of climbing surface making us one of the largest climbing gyms in North America. Our numerous climbs range from beginner climbs to routes that will challenge the most advanced climbers.  
  
• 110 ft. outdoor wall with toproped and leadable routes in the summer. Lighted for night climbing.  
• Rappel 120 ft. off the top of the building with an elevator ride to the top.  
• Massive multi-level bouldering cave and training area.  
• At 30' tall the main area includes slab, aretes, roofs, dihedrals, cracks, and the wave wall.  
• The silos are 65 ft. tall. Three are round and two are uniquely shaped featuring stem and chimney type climbs. Each silo contains eight or nine topropes and all routes are leadable.  
• Facilities include showers, lockers, water fountain, pop and snack machines, lounge, rest rooms, world-class pro shop, and complete gear rentals.  
• Classes and programs are available for every age and type of group.  
• All climbers must sign a waiver. Anyone under 18 must have a waiver signed by a parent or legal guardian.  
• Outdoor bouldering area with more than 1,700 square feet of climbing surface that is lit for climbing at night.

About BioEcho Life Sciences GmbH
--------------------------------

BioEcho Life Sciences is a specialized solution provider for the extraction and analysis of nucleic acids. We create disruptive technologies, products, and workflows that make downstream processing of nucleic acids easier and faster, significantly increase throughput, and deliver reliable results.  
  
Our EchoLUTION technology enables the fastest DNA and RNA extraction on the market - in just one single step. It reduces the associated plastic consumption by up to 70 %.  
  
Customers in molecular diagnostics, academic and biopharmaceutical research, plant and animal breeding rely on our products: ready-to-use kits, high-throughput solutions for automation platforms, nucleic acid extraction services and process optimization for molecular biology laboratories.  
  
BioEcho, located in Cologne, Germany, was founded in 2016 by leading industry experts and is certified according to ISO 9001 and ISO 13485. During the pandemic, our Viral RNA/DNA Swab kit was used in up to 15 % of Covid PCR tests in Germany and 50 % of tests in Austria.  
  
Through our European direct Sales team, our global distributor network, and our international online shop we serve a worldwide growing customer base with best-in-class products and services.  
BioEcho. The Nucleic Acid Experts.

About John Locke Foundation
---------------------------

The John Locke Foundation was created in 1990 as an independent, nonprofit think tank that would work “for truth, for freedom, and for the future of North Carolina.” The Foundation is named for John Locke (1632-1704), an English philosopher whose writings inspired Thomas Jefferson and the other Founders. The John Locke Foundation is a 501(c)(3) research institute and is funded solely from voluntary contributions from individuals, corporations, and charitable foundations.  
  
JLF’s Vision  
  
The John Locke Foundation envisions a North Carolina of responsible citizens, strong families, and successful communities committed to individual liberty and limited, constitutional government.  
  
JLF’s Mission  
  
The John Locke Foundation employs research, journalism, and outreach programs to transform government through competition, innovation, personal freedom, and personal responsibility. JLF seeks a better balance between the public sector and private institutions of family, faith, community, and enterprise.

About Golder Ranch Fire District
--------------------------------

The Golder Ranch Fire District was created in 1977 by a vote of the residents in the area. The homeowners wanted to have a voice in their fire and medical care and at the same time, monitor costs. Today the District serves a 222 square mile area with a population of nearly 60,000 residents. Included in the District are the communities of Oro Valley, Catalina, SaddleBrooke and southern Pinal County.  
  
Golder Ranch is governed by a five-person, non-partisan board elected at large by the voters of the District. Board members are elected to alternating four-year terms so there are at least two members elected every two years. The Board establishes policy, sets tax rates, approves the budget, and hires the Fire Chief. The Board also has sole authority to set policy regarding future annexation. As a special district of the State, Golder Ranch must comply with all applicable Arizona Revised Statutes such as the Open Meeting Law. The District holds public meetings on the second Tuesday of every month at the Fire District Administration Office.

About London Fire Brigade
-------------------------

London Fire Brigade is the busiest fire and rescue service in the country. What's more, we are one of the largest firefighting and rescue organisations in the world protecting people and property from fire within the 1587 square kilometers of Greater London.  
  
We are the only UK fire service where all operational staff are full-time. Other brigades use a combination of full and part-time staff and retained firefighters who carry out firefighting duties in addition to their usual employment. To provide a round-the-clock service, we operate a two shift, four-watch system at stations – red, white, blue and green.  
  
Control staff take emergency 999 calls, find out details of incidents, send fire engines and deploy our resources to emergencies. They also use a six-watch system but have a different rank structure.  
  
It's not just firefighters who help make London a safer city. We have a range of non-uniformed and non-operational staff who work behind the scenes to support our front-line services, including IT, Finance, Procurement and Community Safety officers.

Campbell University, located at 450 Leslie Campbell Ave, Buies Creek, NC, is dedicated to graduating students equipped with exemplary academic and professional skills, preparing them for purposeful lives and meaningful service. This commitment to academic excellence has earned Campbell the distinction of being one of only three private universities in North Carolina to achieve the highest level of accreditation from the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools.  
  
Nestled in the vibrant Research Triangle Region, Campbell University benefits from its proximity to a dynamic hub of businesses, educational institutions, and governmental organizations, consistently ranked among the best places to live and work in the U.S. This advantageous location provides students with invaluable real-world experiences and networking opportunities that enhance their career readiness. In addition to the main campus in Buies Creek, Campbell operates campuses in Raleigh, the Research Triangle Park, and on military installations at Fort Liberty and Camp Lejeune, further expanding access to quality education.  
  
For those interested in the academic environment, a comprehensive Campbell University teachers list is available, showcasing the dedicated faculty who are committed to fostering an engaging and supportive learning atmosphere. About Sophie Blackall

Sophie Blackall is a renowned Australian artist and author, known for her distinctive and captivating artwork that has garnered widespread acclaim. With a career spanning over two decades, her work has graced the pages of numerous books, featured in prominent galleries, and earned her accolades and awards from the literary and artistic communities.  
  
Born and raised in Australia, Blackall honed her artistic skills at the Queensland College of Art before embarking on a journey that would take her around the world. Her experiences and travels have greatly influenced her art, infusing it with a sense of wonder, curiosity, and a deep appreciation for human connection. This is evident in her illustrations, which often depict scenes of everyday life, each imbued with a sense of magic and whimsy.  
  
Blackall's career as an artist took off when she moved to New York City, where she quickly made a name for herself in the highly competitive world of illustration. Her work caught the attention of publishers, and she soon found herself collaborating with some of the most esteemed authors in the literary world. Her illustrations have graced the pages of over 30 books, ranging from children's picture books to novels for adults. Her art has enhanced the storytelling of beloved authors such as Jacqueline Woodson, Meg Rosoff, and Jane Yolen, among many others.  
  
One of Blackall's most notable accomplishments is her work on the New York Times bestselling series, "Ivy and Bean." Her whimsical illustrations brought to life the misadventures of two spirited young girls, captivating readers of all ages and earning her a devoted following. The series has been praised for its relatable characters, witty storytelling, and, of course, Blackall's enchanting artwork.  
  
In addition to her achievements as an illustrator, Blackall has also made a name for herself as a talented author. Her debut as a writer and illustrator, "Missed Connections: Love, Lost & Found," showcases her ability to weave poignant and heartfelt narratives through both words and art. The book was inspired by real-life "missed connections" ads posted on Craigslist, which Blackall transformed into a collection of tender and evocative illustrations, each paired with its own unique story. The book resonated with readers and critics alike, earning her the prestigious Caldecott Medal, the highest honor in the world of children's book illustration.  
  
As an artist, Sophie Blackall's work is characterized by its timeless appeal, intricate details, and a subtle, yet unmistakable sense of emotion. Her illustrations often feature a muted, earthy color palette, creating a sense of warmth and familiarity that draws viewers in. Whether she is depicting a bustling city street, a serene countryside, or a cozy family home, her art evokes a sense of nostalgia and a longing for simpler times. Her ability to capture the beauty of everyday life has made her a beloved figure in the world of illustration.  
  
In addition to her work in books, Blackall's art has been exhibited in galleries and museums around the world. Her solo exhibitions have been met with critical acclaim, showcasing her talent for storytelling through the visual medium. Her art speaks to audiences of all ages, transcending cultural and linguistic barriers, and fostering a sense of empathy and connection among those who experience it.  
  
As an Australian artist and author, Sophie Blackall has left an indelible mark on the world of illustration and storytelling. Her ability to capture the magic of everyday life and infuse it into her art has earned her a dedicated following and a reputation as a true master of her craft. With each new project, she continues to enchant audiences with her evocative illustrations and heartfelt storytelling, solidifying her place as an artist and author of extraordinary talent and vision.

How can I become a member of the Pittsburg Chamber of Commerce?

To become a member of the Pittsburg Chamber of Commerce, you can visit their official website and complete the membership application form. Membership is open to all businesses and organizations in the Pittsburg area.
